parameters.name: AgentGroup
parameters.description:
Task network type. Valid values:

- PC: Cable Network

- MOBILE: Mobile Cellular Network

- FC: Alibaba Cloud VPC Network

parameters.name: Keyword
parameters.description:
The keyword to be matched.

>  You can search for tasks by name or address. Fuzzy search is supported.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description: The ID of the site monitoring task.

parameters.name: TaskState
parameters.description:
The task status. Valid values:

*   1: The task is enabled.
*   2: The task is disabled.

parameters.name: TaskType
parameters.description: The protocol that is used by the site monitoring task. Valid values: HTTP, PING, TCP, UDP, DNS, SMTP, POP3, and FTP.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms describe-site-monitor-list --task-id a1ecd34a-8157-44d9-b060-149508370000 --task-type HTTP --keyword site --page 1 --page-size 10 --task-state 1 --agent-group PC --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cms DescribeSiteMonitorList --region cn-hangzhou --TaskId 'a1ecd34a-8157-44d9-b060-149508370000' --Keyword site --PageSize 10 --TaskType HTTP --AgentGroup PC --Page 1 --TaskState 1
